manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through the top of its flight with a ball dropped from rest at that same instant.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top of the toss, velocity is instantly zero, but constant gravity gives both balls identical downward acceleration.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
